% Pattern: number/style. A theorem style whose head spec is
% {\thmname{#1}\thmnote{ #3}} does not print the number, and the note
% \ref{thm:main} prints the number of thm:main. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want repthm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheoremstyle{again}{\topsep}{\topsep}{\itshape}{}{\bfseries}{.}{ }{\thmname{#1}\thmnote{ \bfseries #3}}
\theoremstyle{again}
\newtheorem{repthm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\section{Two}
\begin{repthm}[\ref{thm:main}] Every finite space is compact. \end{repthm}
\end{document}
